Milk

Financial Health Assessment:
The company demonstrates strong profitability with a 50% gross profit margin ($300,000 gross profit on an implied $600,000 in revenue). Operating income is healthy at $150,000, indicating that core business operations are efficient with operating expenses consuming only 50% of gross profit. After accounting for interest and taxes, the net income is $100,000, resulting in a net profit margin of approximately 16.7%. The company appears financially stable with solid earnings power.
